description: Tidegap: at session start, name the tasks this session queued that finished unread (ids, status, how they ran; never their text), and print one line for other unread tasks (silent when nothing is unread or the tidegap CLI is not installed; falls back to the 0.17 ebb command). At session start and end, keep ~/.tidegap/sessions/claude-<pid>.json current, so a task queued from this session knows which session asked for it. Before each prompt, when tasks this session queued have finished, add one notice naming them (ids, status, titles, result files; never their text) and record that the session saw it (silent and without starting tidegap when there is nothing to say). When a turn ends and a task this session queued with a wake is pending, wait in the background (at most 12 hours, while the session runs) and wake the idle session with that notice when the task finishes (nothing starts without such a task). When a prompt asks for recurring work ("every night", "set up a cron", "каждый день"), add one context line that points the agent at Tidegap jobs instead of cron. Before a Bash call that edits a crontab, loads a launchd agent, enables a systemd user unit or authors a Tidegap command job, ask the user first (never deny).

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if command -v tidegap >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | tidegap queue list --unread --hook --hook-input - 2>/dev/null || tidegap queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; elif command -v ebb >/dev/null 2>&1; then ebb queue list --unread --hook 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
